Travel to [[Fort Aspenwood (Luxon)]] and speak with the [[Luxon Commander]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Fort Aspenwood (Luxon)|Fort Aspenwood]] and speak to the [[Luxon Commander]].

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Leaving from [[Zos Shivros Channel (outpost)|Zos Shivros Channel]], head west through [[Boreas Seabed (explorable area)]] and [[Mount Qinkai]]. Alternatively, you can leave from [[Cavalon]] into [[Archipelagos]] and through [[Breaker Hollow]].

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Elder Rhea
:''"If you want to help defeat those useless Kurzicks, we can certainly use your help in our raid on '''Fort Aspenwood'''. Rumor has it that they are developing some sort of secret weapon there, and they must be stopped! Some of our troops have already begun the assault, but they're going to need reinforcements."''

:''"Will you help us destroy Fort Aspenwood?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Fort Aspenwood will fall!
|decline = It's a lost cause.
|ask = Our troops have already begun the attack on '''Fort Aspenwood''', but they need reinforcements. Travel there as quickly as you can, and speak with the Luxon Commander once you arrive. 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Luxon Commander
:''"Elder Rhea sent you? Well, you've made it just in time; we're ready to begin the final assault."''

==Notes==

The Kurzick equivalent of this quest is [[Defend Fort Aspenwood]].
